title: Review round 2: Implement jmap-client crate
description: Second review pass after fix wave from round 1. All P0/P1/P2 findings from round 1 are fixed.
notes:
Maintainer risk round 2: HIGH — request_timeout silently not applied to blobs (documented but broken), upload response limit hardcoded outside ClientConfig, ClientConfig has no non_exhaustive (every new field is a breaking change), dual StateChange types in ws and sse fossilize as separate public API, zero-value limits silently accepted.
Calibration: ~10% chance of missed bug. P0=2 unique (upload/download request_timeout ignored; SSE UTF-8 multi-byte split), P1=4 unique (two StateChange types; zero-value limits; mixed panic/Result in builder; upload response cap hardcoded), P2=2 (upload_blob Vec<u8> ergonomics; connect_ws auth param type mismatch), opinion=3 labeled. Several duplicates across sub-agents (request_timeout filed 3x; hardcoded cap filed 2x). Running out of real complaints: yes — the remaining unfiled issues are micro-allocations and style preferences.
